nodes.description: Owner address, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor; guards onlyOwner functions.
Pending owner used by the two-step ownership transfer in Owned.
Token symbol string, set to "HLCN" in the constructor.
Token name string, set to "Healthy Coin" in the constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply minted to the fixed address in the constructor.
Mapping(address => uint) holding token balances.
Mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding spending allowances.
HLCN constructor: sets symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and credits the initial holder.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decrements the caller allowance without checking it.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract (arbitrary external callback).
Payable fallback function that immediately reverts.
onlyOwner function that performs an external ERC20 transfer of arbitrary tokens held by the contract.
Owned constructor: owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function setting newOwner (pending owner).
Requires msg.sender == newOwner, then transfers ownership and clears newOwner.
Checked addition: c = a + b with require(c >= a).
Checked subtraction: require(b <= a) then c = a - b.
Caller-controlled address used for balances, allowances and ownership checks.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an attacker-controlled address.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary token address.
Unchecked arithmetic _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with no SafeMath guard.
Address parameter 'to' in transfer/transferFrom (recipient).
uint parameter 'tokens' in transfer/approve/transferFrom/approveAndCall (amount).
Address parameter 'spender' in approve/approveAndCall.
Address parameter 'from' in transferFrom (source of funds).
Address parameter 'tokenAddress' in transferAnyERC20Token (arbitrary external token).
Address parameter '_newOwner' in transferOwnership.
bytes parameter 'data' forwarded to the receiveApproval callback.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
transfer reads and debits balances[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callback.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner, which requires msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before changing owner.
transferAnyERC20Token is onlyOwner and moves tokens to owner.
'to' recipient receives credit in transfer.
'tokens' amount is debited/credited in transfer.
'to' recipient receives credit in transferFrom.
'tokens' amount is moved in transferFrom.
'from' is the debited source address in transferFrom.
'spender' key selects the allowance slot in approve.
'tokens' amount becomes the allowance value in approve.
'spender' is both the allowance key and the called contract in approveAndCall.
'tokens' becomes the allowance and is forwarded to receiveApproval.
'data' is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
'tokenAddress' targets the external contract called in transferAnyERC20Token.
'_newOwner' is stored into the newOwner state variable.
transfer calls safeSub for the sender debit.
transfer calls safeAdd for the recipient credit.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient credit.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction that may underflow.
approveAndCall invokes an arbitrary external contract which can call back into the token.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes an external ERC20 contract chosen by the owner.
Owned constructor writes owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership writes the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
HLCN constructor sets _totalSupply.
HLCN constructor credits balances of the initial holder.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer writes sender and recipient entries in balances.
transferFrom writes 'from' and 'to' entries in balances.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] without an allowance check.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.

Parameter 'from' is the debited source account of HLCN.transferFrom; merge it into that function node.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' is the target of the external call in HLCN.transferAnyERC20Token; merge it into that function node.
Parameter '_newOwner' is written into newOwner by Owned.transferOwnership; merge it into that function node.
